Black—Victini and Reshiram| enva=[[Khristine Hvam]]| java=Mao Daichi| }} '''Juanita''' (Japanese: '''ジャンタ''' ''Janta'') is a character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. She is the mother of [[Damon]] and [[Carlita]], as well as a descendant of the People of the Vale. ==In the movies== {{spoilers}} Juanita owns a souvenir shop in [[Eindoak Town]] that she operates with the assistance of her {{p|Golurk}}, selling various Victini-related goods during the [[Eindoak Harvest Festival]]. [[File:Younger Damon.png|thumb|220px|left|Juanita and her young son]] Years prior to the events of the movies, Juanita and her son Damon traveled to the ruined site where the [[Kingdom of the Vale]] once stood. Expressing a wish for the People of the Vale to be able to again live there, Juanita instilled the dream that would drive Damon's actions years later. In the present, when Damon explained his goals to his family, Juanita and Carlita supported him, along with Eindoak Town's mayor [[Mannes]]. However, they soon realized how far he was willing to go to accomplish the resurrection of the Kingdom of the Vale, including harming Victini and destroying the land because of the released [[Dragon Force]]. Juanita made a desperate bid to stop her son, sending Golurk to fight Damon's {{OBP|Reshiram|M14}} or {{OBP|Zekrom|M14}}. Her efforts failed, but before Reshiram or Zekrom could deliver a finishing blow to Golurk, the other dragon appears under the control of {{Ash}} intervened. Later, when the [[Sword of the Vale]] castle began flying out of control, Juanita evacuated on Mannes's helicopter and sent her Golurk to save Damon from falling to his death. She is last seen once the Sword of the Vale is set down in a new location, encouraging Damon to fulfill their shared dream by aiding in the construction of a new Kingdom of the Vale there. Juanita made a cameo appearance in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a continuity separate from {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was seen with her Golurk in Eindoak Town. ===Character=== Juanita is warm and gentle-natured. She is well-versed in the history and legends surrounding her ancestors, the People of the Vale, instilling such traditions and stories in her own children from a young age. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Juanita |pkmn=Golurk |shiny=yes |type1=Ground |type2=Ghost |img=Juanita Golurk White.png |img2=Juanita Golurk Black.png |epnum=M14 |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom
Black—Victini and Reshiram |vaen= |desc=Juanita's {{p|Golurk}} acts as her assistant and partner at her souvenir shop. In ''White—Victini and Zekrom'', it is normal-colored. The normal-colored Golurk briefly reappeared in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a continuity separate from {{aniseries|PTS}}. She also plays a similar role from the movie. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Juanita |pkmn=Golurk |type1=Ground |type2=Ghost |img=Juanita Golurk M14 manga.png |epnum=White—Victini and Zekrom (manga) |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom |desc=Juanita sent out {{p|Golurk}} to stop Reshiram when Damon told it to stall the protagonists while he took control of the [[Kingdom of the Vale]]. Golurk tried its best with Reshiram but Reshiram was too powerful after it got hit badly by the dragon's attack. Golurk's only known move is {{m|Hyper Beam}}.}} ==In the games== A {{p|Golurk}} based on Juanita's {{Shiny}} Golurk was distributed to the Japanese players of {{game|Black and White|s|Pokémon White}} at [[Nintendo Zone]]s in Japan starting on June 17, 2011, then were also distributed over Wi-Fi starting on July 8, 2011. Both the Nintendo Zone and the Wi-Fi distributions ended on September 8, 2011.
